name: DS3231 RTC Module
fullName: DS3231 Extremely Accurate I2C Real-Time Clock (RTC) with TCXO & Battery Backup
tagline: Temperature-compensated real-time clock maintaining time with ±2ppm accuracy
description: The DS3231 is a low-cost, extremely accurate I2C real-time clock (RTC) with an integrated temperature-compensated crystal oscillator (TCXO) and crystal. Includes a battery input (CR2032/LIR2032) to keep track of seconds, minutes, hours, day, date, month, and year even when main circuit power is disconnected.

specs.accuracy: ±2ppm from 0°C to +40°C (less than 1 minute per year drift)
specs.features: Two programmable time-of-day alarms, 32.768 kHz square-wave output, onboard 32KB EEPROM (AT24C32)

wiringNote: If using standard disposable CR2032 coin cells (non-rechargeable), remove or disable the onboard charging diode/resistor circuit on cheap clone modules.
commonMistakes: Inserting a dead or missing coin cell battery
Setting time inside loop() instead of setup() (causes time to reset every second)
